cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a rocky coast path with tide pools — holds an ice cream cone at chest height; a harbour quay of a port town with tall sailing ships — lying on her front; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a city rooftop with a water tank — holds a smartphone at chest height; a sunlit white marble temple — kneeling on the ground; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — standing; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — lying on her front; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — holds a wooden practice sword in a ready guard in front of her; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — holds her keepsake at chest height; a misty enchanted garden of moss — brings a small bouquet up to her face to smell the flowers; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing
